output:
[B1] < cloudA | UserX : ('members' : Members, ...) , ... > $ UserX 'invite' cloudA | (UserY)
=> < cloudA | UserX : ('members' : (UserY, Members), ...) , ... > .
[B2] < UserX | 'key' : nils, ... > < cloudA | UserX : ('device' : Device, ...) , ... > $ UserX 'openWindow' cloudA | (Device)
=> < UserX | 'key' : FreshKey, ... > < cloudA | UserX : ('device' : Device, ...) , ... > $ cloudA 'openWindow' Device | (FreshKey) .
[B2] < Device | 'key' : nils, ... > $ cloudA 'openWindow' Device | (Key)
=> < Device | 'key' : Key, ... > .
[B2] < Device | 'key' : ExistingKey, ... > $ cloudA 'openWindow' Device | (Key)
=> < Device | 'key' : ExistingKey, ... > .
[B3] < Device | 'key' : Key, 'trusted' : Trusted, ... > $ UserX 'bind' Device | (Key)
=> < Device | 'key' : Key, 'trusted' : (UserX, Trusted), ... > .
[B4] < Device | 'trusted' : (UserX, Trusted), 'on' : false, ... > $ UserX 'turnOn' Device
=> < Device | 'trusted' : (UserX, Trusted), 'on' : true, ... > .
[B5] < cloudA | UserX : ('device' : Device, ...) , ... > $ UserX 'turnOn' cloudA | (Device)
=> < cloudA | UserX : ('device' : Device, ...) , ... > $ cloudA 'turnOn' Device .
[B5] < Device | 'trusted' : (cloudA, Trusted), 'on' : false, ... > $ cloudA 'turnOn' Device
=> < Device | 'trusted' : (cloudA, Trusted), 'on' : true, ... > .
[B6] < cloudA | UserX : ('members' : (UserY, Members), 'device' : Device, ...) , UserY : ('device' : Device, ...) , ... > $ UserX 'removeMember' cloudA | (UserY)
=> < cloudA | UserX : ('members' : Members, 'device' : Device, ...) , UserY : ('device' : nils, ...) , ... > .

< cloudA | (userA : ('members' : nils , 'device' : deviceB) , userC : ('members' : nils , 'device' : nils)) > < userA | ('key' : nils) > < userC | ('key' : nils) > < deviceB | ('on' : false , 'trusted' : cloudA , 'key' : nils) >

[B1] < UserX | ... > < UserY | ... > => ev1(UserX, UserY) .
[B2] < UserX | ... > < Device | ... > => ev2(UserX, Device) .
[B3] < UserX | 'key' : Key , ... > < Device | ... > => ev3(UserX, Device, Key) .
[B4] < UserX | ... > < Device | ... > => ev4(UserX, Device) .
[B5] < UserX | ... > => ev5(UserX, deviceB) .
[B6] < cloudA | UserX : ('members' : (UserY, Rest), ...) , ... > < UserY | ... > => ev6(UserX, UserY) .

deviceOn =| < deviceB | 'on' : true , ... > .
attackerAuthorized =| < cloudA | userC : ('device' : deviceB , ...) , ... > .
